# `aitbc auth login`

Log in with a wallet-signed nonce and store a coordinator JWT.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc auth login [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | `default` | no | Wallet name in AITBC_WALLET_DIR or ~/.aitbc/wallets/ |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--private-key` | text | — | no | Raw hex private key (use only in CI/scripts) |
| `--private-key-file` | path | — | no | File containing a raw hex private key |
| `--wallet-address` | text | — | no | Wallet address (defaults to address derived from private key) |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Coordinator API URL |
| `--environment` | text | `default` | no | Credential environment name |
| `--credential-name` | text | `client` | no | Name the credential is stored under (e.g. 'admin' for aitbc monitor sweepers) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc auth login
```
